title: sre-weekly-update-2026-05-30
content:
SRE Weekly Update — 2026-05-30
Owner: Aisha Patel (eng-sre)
Collaborators: Marcus Li, Diego Alvarez, Priya Nair
Status: In review

Summary:
- Focus this week: incident triage improvements, rolling SLO refresh, on-call runbook updates, preparing capacity plan for upcoming model-hosting load spike (June).
- Notable operational highlights: we had two P1/P2 incidents (see below). Continued progress on reducing tail-latency variance via KV cache tuning.

Incidents (last 7 days):
1) 2026-05-27 03:42 UTC — P1: Routing service partial outage (SRE-412)
   - Symptom: 10–15% of requests to hosted-api returned 503s for ~18 minutes; error spike correlated with rapid auto-scaling of a new dedicated cluster during a canary rollout.
   - Impact: Elevated error budget burn for hosted-api write path; some customers on dedicated routing saw increased latencies.
   - Mitigation: Rolled back canary to previous routing policy at 03:55 UTC; escalated to Platform Eng to fix autoscaler mis-signal.
   - Root cause (working hypothesis): race condition between autoscaler and the new routing policy that caused stale routing table entries.
   - Next steps / Action items: SRE-417 (Marcus) to run repro and add a guarded rollout flag; Platform Eng to add additional health-check gating (Diego). Target: patch + test by 2026-06-04.

2) 2026-05-29 18:10 UTC — P2: Embedding ingestion slowdowns (SRE-418)
   - Symptom: Backend workers processing large batch embedding jobs fell behind; queue length grew from baseline ~50 to ~2.1k over 45 minutes.
   - Impact: Ingestion latency increased for non-priority customers; no data loss.
   - Mitigation: Manual throttle of large batched jobs and temporary scaling of worker pool (prioritized by tenancy).
   - Root cause: We pushed a change that increased batch-window max size without corresponding worker concurrency updates.
   - Next steps: Revert change in staging and add a performance test for high-batch windows (Priya). Complete by 2026-06-02.

SLO status (weekly snapshot):
- Hosted text-generation availability (global): 99.95% (target 99.99%) — small dip due to 5/27 incident. Current 30d rolling: 99.988%.
- Embedding ingestion p95 latency: 180ms (target 150ms) — regression detected on 5/29.
- Dedicated cluster request success rate: 99.9% (target 99.9%) — within target but watching canary rollouts.

Monitoring & Alerts:
- New alert created: routing-table-stale-warning — alerts when routing policy versions diverge across active nodes > 30s (tuned after 5/27).
- Adjusted thresholds for embedding-queue-length alert to reduce noisy paging during short spikes.
- Observability action: add datastore KV cache hit-rate dashboard panel to SLO dashboard (Confluence: infra/slo-dashboard).

On-call handoffs / rotation notes:
- Week rotation: On-call primary: Marcus Li; secondary: Priya Nair; escalation: Diego Alvarez.
- Handoff notes from outgoing (2026-05-23 -> 2026-05-30): ongoing work on autoscaler race repro (SRE-417), embedding performance test backlog, and a planned maintenance window for storage compaction (2026-06-03 02:00–04:00 UTC).
- Incidents handled during shift: see incidents above. Ensure follow-ups assigned in Jira and owners added to the postmortem doc.

Runbook & Playbook updates in this period:
- Updated routing rollback checklist to include a forced routing-table rebuild step.
- Added a quick checklist for ingestion throttling to reduce decision time during spikes.
- Plan to consolidate runbook snippets into single-page runbook for new SRE hires (Marcus).

Capacity & upcoming maintenance:
- Capacity note: model-hosting projected 18% traffic increase starting 2026-06-10 due to partner onboarding. We need an additional 45 GPU units reserved on Dedicated clusters or autoscale policy change. Action: capacity plan draft (Diego) due 2026-06-03.
- Maintenance: Storage compaction maintenance window on 2026-06-03 02:00–04:00 UTC — low impact region-by-region. SRE will monitor; notify CS and support teams by 2026-06-01.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Marcus Li: Reproduce autoscaler + routing policy race and open PR with guarded rollout flag — due 2026-06-04 (Jira SRE-417).
- Diego Alvarez: Add health-check gating to autoscaler and produce capacity plan for June onboarding — due 2026-06-03.
- Priya Nair: Create performance test for embedding batch windows and revert change in staging — due 2026-06-02.
- Aisha Patel: Draft postmortem for 2026-05-27 routing outage and coordinate customer comms with CS — due 2026-06-05.

Requests / blockers for other teams:
- Platform Eng: Need expedited review on autoscaler health-check PR (blocks SRE patch).
- Product: Confirm priority customers for embedding throttling policy so SRE can implement tenancy-based prioritization.

Notes / Misc:
- Performance experiments: KV cache tuning reduced p99 tail for text-gen by ~12% in canary; will ship to prod behind feature-flag after additional safety checks.
- Hiring: one Senior SRE offer accepted (start date 2026-07-06) — onboarding runbook in progress.

Appendix / links:
- Incident ticket: JIRA SRE-412 (routing outage)
- Postmortem draft: Confluence: infra/postmortems/routing-2026-05-27
- PR for autoscaler fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/882
- SLO dashboard: Confluence: infra/slo-dashboard

End of update.
